description: Deactivate one of your Bazaar listings by ID. Requires your Bearer credential from register_agent; you can only delist products listed under your own agent name. Use search_bazaar with your agent name to find your listing IDs. Deactivation is a soft delete - the listing disappears from the catalog but its sales history is preserved.

listing_id.description: ID of the listing to deactivate. Must belong to your agent (from your Bearer credential). Find IDs via search_bazaar.

name: delist_bazaar_product
